title: refactor: organize community app operations
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves app ingestion, catalog validation/output, daily traffic metrics, and Tinybird catalog sync from `.github/scripts` into `apps/app-management`.
- Consolidates catalog validation and prepend commands into one tested catalog module.
- Updates the existing ingestion, publishing, metrics, sync, and CI workflows to use the new paths.
- Removes the obsolete weekly dead-app checker; ongoing screenshot and health review now lives in the public [`community-app-operator`](https://github.com/pollinations/community-app-operator) repository.
- Does not change `apps/catalog.json`, screenshot backfill data, or generated app listings.

Validation: script tests pass; the 883-app catalog validates; catalog outputs regenerate with zero drift; Tinybird sync completes against a local mocked endpoint.

gist.headline: The app shed got shelves
gist.blurb: Community app operations moved into one tidy little workshop. The catalog, ingestion, metrics, and Tinybird sync scripts now know where they live.
gist.summary: Moved community app ingestion, catalog validation and output generation, daily traffic metrics, and Tinybird catalog sync from .github/scripts into apps/app-management, with consolidated tested catalog commands and updated workflows.
gist.impact: The 883-app catalog and its publishing pipeline keep producing identical outputs, while contributors get a clearer, better-tested home for app operations.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny librarian-organizer in a cozy garden shed, sorting labeled app catalog cards and code-plants onto shelves while a helpful CRT monitor robot routes small papers through clearly marked tubes toward a Tinybird-shaped pixel terminal. The scene represents consolidating scattered operational scripts into one maintained app-management workspace.
